source_read: https://www.gustorestaurants.com/allergen-matrix/ (downloaded fresh 2026-10-08, 7.7 MB, page prints Last Updated: 06/10/2026; robots.txt allows everything), read from the rendered DOM in headless Chromium (cells, Calories, Gluten Type and Tree Nut Type lists) and checked on screenshots of the Dessert and Kids tables
notes: All 172 published items match the page on calories (including the Small/Large pairs) and on all 14 allergen columns (Yes and Yes* both published as contains), gluten cereals and tree-nut types; a re-run of tools/uk_extract/gusto.py on the fresh page reproduces data/source/gusto exactly (only checked_on changed). Calories-only chain, so no other nutrients exist to compare. Held back (allergen row contradicts the dish name / other rows, HOLDBACK added to gusto.py): Aioli 30ml (no egg/mustard though the dishes served with it mark both), Madagascan Vanilla gelato x2 (no milk like no other gelato; Kids sheet marks Gluten, the others none), Dark Chocolate gelato (no milk), Cherry & Custard gelato (no egg), Hazelnut Syrup (no tree nuts). Six 'Make Your Own Pizza: X Only' kids topping rows marked ok (the base is its own Gluten row). Judgement call for the founder: the chain's own menu page flags the vanilla gelato dishes (Classic Affogato, Biscoff Bombolini) vegan, so the vanilla/dark chocolate gelati may truly be dairy-free; they stay held back because the page itself prints no dairy-free wording. The page marks 'Deep Fried' per dish but its allergen text says the fryers hold refined GM soya oil; no soya mark is added (not printed per dish).
